description: **This update fixes the issue that video stops and starts buffering at 1:09 or 1:10!** ### Changes - feat(spoof-player-parameter): Reflect original RVX / ReVanced changes - Add new spoofing type (This solves the buffering at 1:09 issue) - Change patch name ( `protobuf-spoof` -> `spoof-player-parameters` ) - Enabled by default (nonroot only) - Remove automatic enable feature - feat(spoof-app-version): Show reboot dialog after set - feat(spoof-app-version): Move spoofing examples to external webpage ([GitHub Wiki](https://github.com/kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7/wiki/Spoof-app-version-information)) - Add reboot dialog when installing for the first time - Add `os-version-check` patch (default = Excluded) - Update dependencies - Bump revanced-patcher to 12.1.0 ### Announcements • Telegram channel has been opened. https://t.me/rvx_for_a6_7 More info: https://github.com/kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7#telegram- • This update was focused on dealing with the buffering issue, so there are not many changes. I will release the next update in August or September. It will be a general update. includes bug fixes and new features. ※ Compatible ReVanced Manager (official): v1.9.3 ※ Compatible ReVanced Manager (Android 6-7): v1.6.1 ※ Compatible ReVanced CLI: v2.22.0 ※ [Known issues](https://github.com/kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7/wiki/Known-issues)
